ns2:section.sectionText: Section C is offered in a self-paced, online format. Students registered for section C should access the course's Compass site before August 22 for further information about the course requirements and procedures. Seats may be reserved by class level or major. Students unable to add this class who wish to add their names to a wait list, should go to http://hcd.illinois.edu/courses/wait-list and follow Wait List Instructions.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for Human Development & Family St major(s). Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
